SPLADE_COMPLETENESS.completeness_finding: In the current corpus, splade_rank stored only global-top200 membership => ~97-98% of each ~5k scope had splade_rank=-1 (no SPLADE info). Exact scope scoring gives ALL candidates a real score; ~94-96% are nonzero. This removes the 'not-in-top200 => 0' bias the user warned about.
SPLADE_COMPLETENESS.cost: ~0.0045 s / 1000 candidates (CPU scipy). Full scope 2wiki+musique train ~ (75.4M+100.5M) pairs => ~13 min CPU total; trivially cacheable at 2 bytes/pair (f16).

RELATION_AUDIT.exact_semantics_passage_corpora: relation_raw(q,d) = cos(E(q), E(connecting_sentence(topic_title -> candidate_title))). On 2wiki/musique the 'relation' is the SENTENCE in the topic passage that names the candidate title (title-mention edge = A). NOT a KB relation label.
RELATION_AUDIT.exact_semantics_kb: webqsp: relation = Freebase relation on edge q_entity->candidate (text = rel.split('.')[-1]). metaqa: relation parsed from doc facts (directed by / written by / ...). NOT relevant to the C/P50 pilot (text corpora).
inputs_required: Rtext = gte-Qwen encode of the relation-sentence vocab  <-- the EXPENSIVE, NOT-cached step
RELATION_AUDIT.candidate_indexing: per-candidate lookup (doc->entity->edge-from-topic) => POOL-AGNOSTIC: runs on ANY candidate set incl. C/P50.

structural_coverage_upper_bound_C_P50.meaning: frac of P50 candidates with >=1 in-scope title-mention edge (could carry a connecting-sentence relation score). Actual nonzero relation depends additionally on topic-detection hitting the query and the encode.

RELATION_AUDIT.cost_estimate: one gte-Qwen forward pass over the per-dataset relation-sentence vocab (order 1e5-1e6 short sentences). This is the deferred 'expensive feature' build; NOT a cached matmul like dense/splade/offset.
RELATION_AUDIT.flag: CAN_RELATION_RUN_ON_C_P50 = YES (mechanically), but REQUIRES a construction+encode build (not a cached lookup) => gated behind E4.

PATH_AUDIT.exact_semantics: path_raw(q,d) = max over bounded k-hop paths P_K(d) of cos(E(q), E(path_context)). Scored ONLY for path-only candidates (no 1-hop edge). Bounded by path_cap(per-cand) / path_q_cap(per-question) / max_paths(global).
inputs_required: same as relation, plus bounded path enumeration (BFS depth>=2 over A[+NER]) and Ptext = gte-Qwen encode of path-context vocab (EXPENSIVE, not cached)

structural_coverage_C_P50.meaning: frac of P50 candidates reachable in EXACTLY 2 hops via title-mention but NOT 1-hop. ~0 because ~97-98% of scope is already 1-hop reachable within scope; path adds essentially NO new scorable candidates at P50 on these text corpora.

PATH_AUDIT.consistency: matches [[musique-graph-reachability-ceiling]]: 2-hop title-mention chains do not add reachable evidence beyond 1-hop at this scope.
PATH_AUDIT.flag: CAN_PATH_RUN_ON_C_P50 = YES (mechanically) but STRUCTURALLY NEAR-EMPTY at P50 on 2wiki/musique (adds ~0% new candidates) => LOW PRIORITY / likely drop for the text pilot; revisit only on KB (webqsp/metaqa) where multi-hop is the regime.

PROPOSED_TRAINING_ORDER: E0  DENSE-only reranker on C/P50 train-subset (baseline; sanity that corpus trains).
E1  DENSE+SPLADE (exact scope SPLADE) fusion reranker  <-- first real lever; SPLADE completeness now unlocked.
E2  + OFFSET (retrain the offset head ON the C/P50 pool per reuse-rule; do NOT reuse old-pool head as a signal claim).
E3  + MIXTURE-K8 (retrained on C/P50).  [E0-E3 = cheap, cached-family experts]
E3b + cheap GRAPH features (degree/component) as reranker inputs (not a separate expert).
E4  BUILD RELATION feature (construction+encode) on train-subset -> add relation expert; keep only if oracle/reranker lift over E3 is real.
E5  PATH: SKIP on text pilot (near-empty); schedule only when corpus extends to webqsp/metaqa.
GATING: soft per-query controller over the retained experts (crag_fusion/gates), learned on TRAIN regimes; checkpoint-select on VAL; report on TEST once.
NOTE: every expert must be (re)trained on the C/P50 pool before it enters an ablation; never mix pools (reuse-rule).
